title: Autospec explore domain-specialist roster
description: The cached domain-specialist roster written to .autospec/explore-specialists.json by the deterministic signal scan (autospec explore specialists) plus the one-shot LLM roster proposal. Ranked candidate `domains` carry file:line evidence; `suggested_specialists` are the LLM-derived personas dispatched as source=specialist:<slug>. An empty roster (no domain detected) is valid — a generic repo runs the explore loop unchanged.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the roster was cached. Optional; informational only.

domains.description: Ranked candidate domains from the deterministic signal scan, highest-confidence first. Each domain is evidence-grounded — never a bare guess.

suggested_specialists.description: LLM-proposed specialist researchers, capped at --num-specialists (default 3, cap 6). Empty when no domain is detected.

evidence.description: A concrete file:line citation backing a detected domain.

score.description: Number of distinct signal hits backing this domain; the rank key.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case slug used in the source string source=specialist:<slug>.

evidence.description: Repo-derived justification (file:line or signal). Personas derive from repo evidence only; no external persona is injected (trust boundary).
